owner.name: Rusty Calder
owner.bio: Rusty Calder drove roll-offs for one of the big national haulers — long enough to see exactly how the quote games get played. Eventually he bought his own hook-lift truck, painted the boxes safety yellow, and started Sawtooth Dumpster Co. with one rule: the price on the site is the price on the card. He still drives most routes himself, and yes — the number on this page rings in the truck.
